name: International Brigades memorials, Jarama
story: Along the Morata–San Martín de la Vega road, near the XV Brigade's old kitchens at the Venta de Frascuelo, stand memorials to the British, Irish, American, Balkan and Franco-Belgian volunteers who fought on the Jarama. Nearby on the Casas Altas hill a sculpture by Martín Chirino of two clasped hands honours all who fought in the battle. For decades after 1939 the Brigades could not be commemorated in Spain; these memorials were raised by associations and veterans' families after the return of democracy.
see: Memorial stones and plaques by the road, and the Chirino sculpture among trenches and refuge caves.
plan: On Morata's battle route 4; roadside parking. Combine with Suicide Hill (1.5 km) and Pingarrón.
